description: Implementation of the DnsClient class for managing DNS configurations and sessions, including secure and insecure DNS transaction handling, configuration updates, and related utilities.

classes.name: DnsClientImpl
classes.description: Concrete implementation of DnsClient managing DNS configurations, sessions, and fallback logic.

methods.name: CanUseSecureDnsTransactions
methods.description: Checks if secure DNS transactions are available based on current config.

methods.name: CanUseInsecureDnsTransactions
methods.description: Checks if insecure DNS transactions are available based on current config.

methods.name: CanQueryAdditionalTypesViaInsecureDns
methods.description: Determines if additional DNS record types can be queried insecurely.

methods.name: SetInsecureEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables insecure DNS and additional types querying.

methods.name: FallbackFromSecureTransactionPreferred
methods.description: Decides if fallback from secure DNS is preferred based on available servers.

methods.name: FallbackFromInsecureTransactionPreferred
methods.description: Decides if fallback from insecure DNS is preferred based on failure count.

methods.name: SetSystemConfig
methods.description: Sets the system DNS configuration.

methods.name: SetConfigOverrides
methods.description: Overrides DNS configuration with custom settings.

methods.name: ReplaceCurrentSession
methods.description: Replaces the current DNS session with a new one based on current config.

methods.name: GetCurrentSession
methods.description: Returns the current DNS session.

methods.name: GetEffectiveConfig
methods.description: Returns the effective DNS configuration.

methods.name: GetHosts
methods.description: Returns DNS hosts from current config.

methods.name: GetPresetAddrs
methods.description: Retrieves preset IP addresses for a given endpoint.

methods.name: GetTransactionFactory
methods.description: Returns the DNS transaction factory.

methods.name: GetAddressSorter
methods.description: Returns the address sorter.

methods.name: IncrementInsecureFallbackFailures
methods.description: Increments the count of insecure fallback failures.

methods.name: ClearInsecureFallbackFailures
methods.description: Resets the insecure fallback failure count.

methods.name: GetDnsConfigAsValueForNetLog
methods.description: Returns DNS config details for logging.

methods.name: GetSystemConfigForTesting
methods.description: Returns the system DNS config for testing.

methods.name: GetConfigOverridesForTesting
methods.description: Returns current DNS config overrides for testing.

methods.name: SetTransactionFactoryForTesting
methods.description: Sets a custom DNS transaction factory for testing.
